messages:
Anya R.: deploy-bot flagged RC-9 on hold. scanner found HIGH in model-serve/native-io and license ambiguity on bundled codec. holding until triage.

deploy-bot: [scan] RC-9 -> HOLD\\n- vulns: model-serve/native-io: CVE-2025-9999 (HIGH, OOB write)\\n- licenses: third_party/supercodec: signature mismatch, declared license: unknown\\n- report: /artifacts/rc9/scan/1746201111/summary.html

Tom K.: Oof. RC-9 was due for global rollout at 01:00 UTC. We can do a narrower option: drop the native-io and ship with pure-python IO shim for one release. Perf penalty maybe +35ms p99. Thoughts?

Nadia (sec): HIGH CVE in native-io is exploitable under our input path if adversarial payload reaches model input. Can't ship globally. Pure-python shim is acceptable as a mitigation for canary/internal-only, but we need runtime hardening: enable `MODEL_IO_RESTRICT_MODE=1` and limit input size to 1MB for canary.

Anya R.: Legal: what's required to proceed with internal-only canary vs full redistribution?

LegalBot: If the supercodec binary provenance is unknown, Redistributing it externally is blocked. Internal-only canary allowed if artifact removed. We need a manifest confirming removal and a signed attestation for any replaced codec. Redistribution exception requires 72h provenance check.

Tom K.: I can produce a shim build (no native codec) and a canary-only package targeted to APAC regions in ~75 minutes. Will kick off CI now. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/7623

QA Bot: Suggested test matrix: quick smoke, 10k sample inference, perf lap. ETA: 40m after artifact ready.

Nadia (sec): Also recommend enabling sandbox and dropping parallel inference threads to 4 for canary nodes: `INFER_SANDBOX=1; MAX_INFER_THREADS=4`. Post results here.

Anya R.: Action list: 1) Tom - build shim RC by 00:20 UTC. 2) QA - run quick matrix (QA Bot). 3) Nadia - confirm sandbox flags. 4) Legal - review manifest once Tom posts. If QA green we do APAC-only canary 01:10-03:10 UTC. Rollback plan to RC-8 if any crash or error >0.5%.

Tom K.: Build queued. I'll publish artifact and manifest to `/artifacts/rc9/shim/` when done.

deploy-bot: Quick ops tips:
```
/deploy quarantine rc-9 --reason "scanner hold"
/deploy promote rc9-shim --region apac --canary 2 --by @oncall
```

Tom K.: Build finished and manifest uploaded. manifest: /artifacts/rc9/shim/manifest.txt. Artifact SHA: sha256:aa11bb22cc33dde4... (truncated). Native codec not included.

LegalBot: Received manifest. Internal-only canary approved. Redistribution still blocked until provenance found.

QA Bot: Smoke + sample inference run complete. error rate 0.02%, p99 +30ms. Recommend canary.

Nadia (sec): quick fuzz on shim nodes shows no crashes in first 15m. Sandbox flags applied.

Anya R.: Scheduling APAC canary to start 01:10 UTC. I'll monitor dashboards and tag this thread. Rollback thresholds: any crash OR error rate >0.5% OR model tail latency p99 >60% above baseline.

Tom K.: Canary started. dashboard: https://metrics/release/rc9-apac-canary

QA Bot: 45m into canary: error rate steady 0.03%, p99 +33%. no regressions.

Nadia (sec): 30m fuzzing result: no new coverage crashes. Sandbox stable.

Anya R.: APAC canary healthy at 90m. Recommend keeping shim for staged global rollout but legal still needs provenance for supercodec before external redistribution. Propose staged global at +48h after legal clears or earlier if provenance found.

LegalBot: Affirm. I'll continue provenance checks and escalate with upstream vendor. If vendor provides signed provenance artifact we can clear redistribution earlier. Record remediation ticket: SEC-1499.

Tom K.: Noted. I'll prepare rollout plan with a redistribution hold flag so deploy-bot won't promote globally until `--redistribute-allowed` is set.

deploy-bot: Unhold will require: `/deploy unhold rc-9 --by @Anya R. --confirm-redistribution` after legal sign-off. Quarantine command available for rollback: `/deploy rollback rc-8 --reason "canary fail"`.

Anya R.: Thanks team. Updating release notes to indicate temporary shim, perf regression, and legal caveat. Attaching link to this thread in SEC-1499. Closing hold for APAC canary only. :shipit:
